messages.content: Predict one actual human decision/report in a two-person public-goods experiment. Communication with the other participant is prohibited. Roles A and B determine starting token endowments;both people know both amounts. In a contribution decision each simultaneously places an amount c between 0 and their own fresh endowment E into a public fund. All contributed tokens are multiplied by 1.4 and divided equally between the two people,including someone contributing 0. Uncontributed tokens remain private. Own final tokens for a round=E−own contribution+0.7×(own contribution+other contribution). Current other contribution is not shown before simultaneous choices. Tokens describe experimental units;no unsupported cash rate or grading formula is supplied. This is a physical paper-and-pencil task with token choice boxes,a fixed partner and 10 announced rounds. Each round starts with the same fresh role-specific endowment;past earnings are accumulated separately and cannot enlarge the contribution budget. Decisions are made privately before the experimenter collects both choices. After every completed round,own and other contributions,own public-fund share and own accumulated tokens are available. All strictly earlier rounds below are prior experience,not a claim of a current onscreen redisplay. Written instructions say tokens are converted to cash at a ratio determined by the experimenter;the local materials do not establish whether the later paper-reported exchange rate was announced before this decision. The pregame 9 responses are given in this exact order:calm,happy,angry,excited,guilty,dissatisfied,sad,satisfaction with the initial token allocation,fairness of that allocation. Items 1–7 use 1 strongly disagree,2 disagree,3 somewhat disagree,4 neutral,5 somewhat agree,6 agree,7 strongly agree;item 8 uses 1 very dissatisfied through 7 very satisfied,with 4 neutral;item 9 uses 1 very unfair through 7 very fair,with 4 neutral. Responses occurred after knowing the endowments and before contributing. The current target is the actual contribution. Output only the token amount as a number from 0 through the stated own endowment;no explanation.
